explanation: Matches erdosproblems.com/189 with Kovač's negative answer: it is not true that every finite colouring of ℝ² has a colour class containing the vertices of rectangles of every positive area. Rectangles are encoded as convex quadrilaterals (IsCcwConvexPolygon) with consecutive sides perpendicular, and area dist(a,b)·dist(b,c). Formal proof linked.
